description: Create a purchasable product for a Neblla app. type must be "one_time" (single purchase, fixed price), "consumable" (quantity selector, price per unit) or "subscription" (renews every month or year by itself: price per period, interval, optional trialDays; the user manages it with neblla.shop.manage). name should be a multi-language object e.g. { en: "Gold Coins", es: "Monedas de Oro" }. price (one_time, subscription) and pricePerUnit (consumable) are in cents (e.g. 499 = $4.99). A product is a digital entitlement inside the app — a permission or a counter. To sell physical goods, the app collects the order itself; the pattern is in neblla_get_llms({ section: "pagos" }). Payouts go to the developer, so one seller to many buyers works and a multi-seller marketplace does not.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code Stripe charges in, e.g. "usd" (default eur). Prices are in its smallest unit: cents for most, whole units for zero-decimal ones (jpy, krw…), thousandths ending in 0 for bhd, jod, kwd, omr, tnd; a price under Stripe's minimum charge in that currency (0.50 EUR/USD…) is refused

name.description: Product name, string or { en: "...", es: "..." }

price.description: Price in cents — required for one_time, and per period for subscription

pricePerUnit.description: Price per unit in cents — required for consumable

published.description: Buyable right away (default true). Without an active payout account it waits, hidden, and publishes by itself once the account is active (connectUrl opens the onboarding).

name: neblla_create_product
